chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Fadalat ibn Ayyub, from Yahya Al-Jalbi, from Abdullah ibn Suleyman, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), that he recited:

Surely the sign of His kingdom is that there shall come to you the chest in which there is tranquillity from your Lord and residue of the relics of what the children of Musa and the children of Haroun have left, the angels bearing it.
He (peace be upon him) said: 'It is described in the Verse of ‘Al-Baqra’.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Tabut in the verse of Al-Baqarah according to Imam Al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) elucidates the verse of the Tabut (2:248) by linking the angels' carrying of the chest to the imagery of the cow in Surah Al-Baqarah, a connection rooted in the narrative of Prophet Saul (Talut). This exegesis highlights the thematic unity between the miraculous signs of prophetic leadership and the specific surah that details the trial of the Israelites, reinforcing the concept of divine support (sakina) for the chosen leader.
